title: Every agent mistake, a piece of the system: harness engineering at RosmarOps
excerpt: I build, with AI agents, a tool to use AI agents more carefully. This week its bugs were the same ones RosmarOps looks for in yours. This is how we turned each one into a permanent piece of the system.
seo_title: Harness engineering: every agent mistake, a piece
seo_description: Six AI-agent mistakes in one week, and the piece that makes each one impossible to repeat. A real case of AI-First methodology.
alt: An AI agent moves along a track towards five arches: the first is finished and the other four are only outlined. Behind it are several red marks, joined by lines to pieces already placed beside the track, and a hand sets down the next one.
